scope: Two distinct trial-based first-line metastatic squamous NSCLC pembrolizumab/carboplatin/taxane draft routes

primary_references.checked: Trial population, alternative taxanes, induction and pembrolizumab duration.
Sections 1.2 and 14.2 only; no whole-label currency audit.

profile_checks: Confirmed squamous histology; inconsistent namespaces fail.
Explicit stage IV, driver-negative assessment, ECOG 0-1 and adult age.
Explicit choice of one taxane; no assumed partner.
Known authored trial exclusions and malformed boolean exclusion values withhold selection.
regimen_invariants: Exactly pembrolizumab, carboplatin and one taxane per regimen.
Four chemotherapy induction cycles; pembrolizumab maximum includes induction.
No non-squamous trial outcomes or unverified NCCN grade copied.
translation_status: Clinical drafts retain original wording when a translation is not authored; new questionnaire labels are not fully localized.
open_risks: These checks are not an exhaustive eligibility or administration protocol.
Trial-scope withholding is not a declaration of universal clinical contraindication.
Histology and molecular assessment are caller-supplied; source-document grounding is not independently verified.
Other NSCLC routes and biomarker eligibility require further audit.
Full-browser offline operation and screen-reader speech remain unproven.
